pkgmetadata.longdescription: Meeting recorder for Omarchy: captures the microphone and the computer audio in two tracks and transcribes them locally (whisper.cpp and sherpa-onnx are built into the binary), with speakers, chapters and a player. Ships the prebuilt binary, desktop entry, the application/x-omarchy-meeting shared-mime type and the quickshell bar widget. The ~1.6 GB speech model is fetched on first use, or reused from voxtype when present.
